observations.description: Canonical individual observation documents. They do not contain parentSetId or embedded set data.

observationSets.description: Canonical grouping documents. They do not contain member IDs or embedded observations.

observationSetMemberships.description: The only relation between observations and sets. A document is physically removed when detaching an observation.
invariants: at most one document exists for each (observationSetId, observationId) tuple
uid equals the uid of both endpoint documents
position belongs to the membership rather than either endpoint

accessControl.membershipRead: a readable set may expose membership identifiers, but each observation document applies its own ACL before content is read

clientWrites.observationAndSetDelete: logical-only; set deletion does not cascade to observations or memberships
clientWrites.membershipDelete: physical-only; detaching does not delete either endpoint

requiredFor: owner, visibility, and shared-email observation-set feeds
observation-set membership projection ordered by position and deterministic document ID
